announcement.msg_id: ARA 4.5.1 hadir dengan MODE ANALISIS KINERJA: 10 papan analisis berlatar putih — matahari, radiasi, angin (CFD), energi & GREENSHIP/LEED, HVAC, air, listrik, net zero, evakuasi, diagram lapisan — untuk semua jenis bangunan. Ketik kota proyek, sudut matahari dihitung ARA. Cari preset [ANALISIS]. Tidak muncul update otomatis? Unduh di github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
announcement.msg_en: ARA 4.5.1 brings PERFORMANCE ANALYSIS MODE: 10 white analysis boards — sun path, solar radiation, wind (CFD), energy & GREENSHIP/LEED, HVAC, water, electrical, net zero, evacuation, layer diagram — for any building type. Type the project city and ARA computes the sun angles. Look for the [ANALISIS] presets. No automatic update prompt? Download it at github.com/gigihwicaksono09-spec/ARA_AURUM/releases (SmartScreen: More info → Run anyway).
